Fixed March 1st, 2019 as the record date for the payment of 2nd Interim Dividend for the Financial year 2018-194. Steel City Securities Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on January 28, 2019 at 3.30 P.M. at the registered office of the Company situated at 49-52-5/4, Shanthipuram, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, and the following is the outcome of the Board Meeting:1. Appointment of M/s. ASN Associates, Company Secretaries as Secretarial Auditors of the Company for the Financial Year 2018-19. 2. Appointment of M/s. Rao & Manoj, Chartered Accountants as Internal Auditors of the Company for the Financial Year 2018-19 to carry on the Internal Audit of the Financials of the Company.3. Appointment of M/s.
